chapter_theme: Archana, worship with flowers, scented pastes, food offerings and lamps: offered with love it brings everything from wealth and the eight siddhis to release. Yet those given to Siva, the Siva-yogis and the desireless need no rites, and the chapter turns inward to the Lord known within, the syllables of the mantra placed in the body, and the nectar and light of Siva.
structure_note: Outer worship and its fruits (1003 to 1006); the worshipper's fitness and those beyond rites (1007, 1008); inner knowing, the mantra in the body and the state of union (1009 to 1014).

1003.reading: Offer lotus, blue lily, water lily, the fine neythal, fragrant areca blossom, madhavi, mandaram, thumbai, vakulam, surapunnai, jasmine, champak, pathiri and chrysanthemum.
1003.nuance: The verse is only a list of flowers ending in the command சாத்திடே (offer, adorn). It sets the outward rite that 1008 will say some need not perform.

1004.reading: Mix sandal with fragrant kunkumam, camphor and dark agil, blended properly with rosewater as part of the rite, and adorn and worship with love.
1004.nuance: சாங்கமதாகவே is taken as 'with its proper limbs', the rite done complete; சந்தொடு is unclear. The verse closes on அன்பொடே: the materials are listed, but love is the manner required.

1005.reading: Standing in love, offering the food offering and setting golden lamps and incense and lights in every direction, when worshippers who have put away sorrow think on him, release comes to them with joy.
1005.nuance: துன்பம் அகற்றி can be what the worshippers do (putting sorrow aside) or what the worship does (removing their sorrow). அமுது here is the food offered (naivedya).

1006.reading: If you come and worship there is nothing you cannot reach: first Indra's wealth, then the eight siddhis, and at last release.
1006.nuance: Each line opens with எய்தி வழிப்படில், and the fruits climb from worldly wealth to powers to release. எய்தி may mean coming near the Lord or having attained the means.

1007.reading: Those who have left desire for others' wives and quenched the senses, with pure food offerings, attentive contemplation, the five-limbed prostration and repetition of the mantra, have minds that settle with the breath.
1007.nuance: அவித்தார் has no stated object; the senses are the usual reading. பஞ்சாங்கம் may be the five-limbed prostration or a five-part rite, and அனுசந்தானம் steady inner attention. மனம் பவனத்தோடு வைகும் is a yogic note: the mind abiding with the breath.

1008.reading: Those who have become servants of the Stainless One, those who have no desire for it, the great Siva-yogis and the eminent who have searched it out do not want ritual works; they want love.
1008.nuance: கன்மம் here is most naturally the ritual work the chapter has been prescribing, though it can also mean deeds and their fruit. The last line is compressed: ஆய்ந்து அன்பே, 'having examined, love', taken as love being what they keep.

1009.reading: No one knows him through the knowledge that is hard to reach; people seek through the senses and lament, but if they look steadily within the house of the way, he can be found inside the struck bell.
1009.nuance: பொறிவழி (the way of the senses) is set against looking within. நெறிமனை, the house of the path, is taken as the body; எறிமணி, the struck bell, is traditionally the inner sound heard in meditation, though it could also be the bell of temple worship.

1010.reading: The heart is twofold, like darkness and light: delusion and ignorance, and abiding knowledge; ignorance that does not cast off these delusions stays bewildered, and only those who have broken delusion are the knowers.
1010.nuance: The pairing of இருள் and வெளி (darkness and open light) for ignorance and knowledge in the one heart is the image. The last line is elliptical: அவர்களாம் supplies 'they are the ones' without saying what.

1011.reading: When the self becomes He and He becomes the self, the knower of the two becomes Siva; this is the love of one who has reached the fourth way, and he becomes Him.
1011.nuance: நாலாம் மரபு is traditionally the fourth of the four paths (charya, kriya, yoga, jnana). The verse calls union a form of love (அன்பு). ஓராசித்த தேவரே is obscure.

1012.reading: Om always rests below the navel, the unfailing syllable va is in the long throat, na abides in the forehead, and swelling bindu and nada are above.
1012.nuance: This is a placing of mantra syllables in the body (nyasa). Only Om, va and na are named, and why they sit where they do is not explained; the usual placings of the five syllables differ.

1013.reading: Nama, the seat, is the soul; Sivam, the attainment, is Siva the Lord; when nama falls away there is no more seeking the First; to join the great silence that is Siva is true release.
1013.nuance: The verse splits நமசிவாய: நம is the பசு, the bound soul, as the seat (ஆசனம்), and சிவ the பதி. Line 3 (நமவற ஆதி நாடுவது அன்றாம்) is obscure; it may mean that once the soul's part ceases, the search ends. மாமோனம் is the great silence.

1014.reading: On the day clarity comes, Siva's nectar wells up; on the day light comes, it leaps in a single petal; if in that state the two become one, the Lord who gives the open space remains as that space.
1014.nuance: ஓர்ஏட்டில் (in one petal or leaf) may refer to a lotus centre in yogic anatomy. ஓர் இரண்டு ஆகில் can be 'if the two become one' or 'if one becomes two'. வெளி, open space, is the Lord's own nature here.

links.note: 1003 to 1006 prescribe flowers, pastes and lamps and promise every fruit; 1008 says the Lord's servants, the Siva-yogis and the desireless do not want such ritual work, only love.
1012 places the mantra's syllables in the body; 1013 says what the parts of நமசிவாய stand for: நம the bound soul, சிவ the Lord.

Both promise the end of sorrow to those who come to the Lord's feet; Tirumular reaches it through worship with lamps and offerings, the Kural through reaching the feet of the one without liking or aversion.
The Kural praises the path of the one who quenched the five senses; Tirumular says those who seek through the senses (பொறிவழி) only lament, and the Lord is found within.

source_issues: 1008 line 1: ஆட்பட்டோ ர் has a stray space (ஆட்பட்டோர்).
1011 line 4 (ஓராசித்த தேவரே) is obscure and may be corrupt.
